https://shopify.dev/changelog/tax-webhoo: The change is in what Shopify sends to tax apps (calculation requests and tax summary webhook payloads), not in a call the app makes, and SHAPI matches the calls an app makes.
https://shopify.dev/changelog/invalid-me: Whether a query breaks depends on the metafield filter inside a search string and on how the store's metafield definitions are configured, neither of which a scan of the code can see.
https://shopify.dev/changelog/removal-of: Removes an error code that can no longer occur; code that handles ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION keeps working, it just never runs.
https://shopify.dev/changelog/reduced-me: The limit applies to the size of a JSON metafield value written at runtime, which a scan of the code can't know; existing apps keep the 2 MB limit.
